summary: IdP-initiated RelayState double-encoding mangles tenant routing in private deployment
description: Customer reports that IdP-initiated SSO redirects to Redwood but tenant resolution fails intermittently when RelayState is used. Symptoms: user lands on Redwood login flow, is issued a valid session cookie, but tenant header is missing and RBAC denies access to customer-admin endpoints (403). Occurs only for IdP-initiated flows; SP-initiated flows work. This is a private deployment (VPC) with an on-prem IdP that appears to URL-encode RelayState twice. Customer uses a RelayState that contains tenant_hint as a query string (tenant=beacon-prod).
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Customer triggers IdP-initiated SAML login with RelayState='https://app.redwood.example/?tenant=beacon-prod'

2) IdP performs URL encoding twice on RelayState (first by IdP app, second by corporate SSO proxy), produces RelayState value with percent-encoding and encoded '=' as '%3D' plus percent signs encoded again
3) Redwood ingress receives SAML Response with RelayState header/param containing double-encoded payload
4) Identity proxy decodes RelayState once and extracts tenant_hint from the querystring; because value remains percent-encoded the tenant parser fails to match namespace, sets tenant to null
5) User receives session cookie but requests to admin/console routes are denied (403) due to missing tenant-scoped RBAC bindings
logs: 2026-03-13T08:12:21Z ingress[auth-proxy] INFO received SAMLResponse for user=alice@beacon.example RelayState=%25253A%25252F%25252Fapp.redwood.example%25252F%253Ftenant%253Dbeacon-prod
2026-03-13T08:12:22Z authz ERROR tenant header missing, defaulting to none; request_id=af3b2c
2026-03-13T08:12:23Z audit INFO session-created user=alice@beacon.example tenant=null method=saml idp=onprem-sso proxy=corp-proxy-1
comments: 2026-03-13 09:04 - Support (Asha): Opened with customer-provided SAML bundle and redacted RelayState examples. Customer confirms only IdP-initiated flows are affected.

2026-03-13 11:20 - Customer (BeaconHealth SSO admin - Rajesh Kumar): We rolled our SSO proxy on Sunday which introduced URL normalization. SP-initiated flows work because we append tenant_hint server-side, but IdP-initiated ones pass through encoded RelayState. Happy to provide packet captures under NDA.

2026-03-13 14:02 - SRE (Miguel): Reproduced in staging by simulating double-encoded RelayState. Identity-proxy currently performs single decode; tenant parser expects raw querystring. Hypothesis: either adjust ingress to decode RelayState twice when header matches pattern OR change tenant parser to handle percent-encoded kv pairs. Will investigate trade-offs.

2026-03-13 16:10 - Support (Asha): Customer asked for immediate workaround. Suggested mapping tenant to a claim/attribute at the IdP to bypass RelayState; customer says mapping not possible for legacy app.

2026-03-14 07:45 - Engineering (Miguel): Drafted small change to identity-proxy that attempts a second RelayState decode when the initial parse yields an unrecognized tenant pattern. Created draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/identity-proxy/pull/2746 and flagged with security review. Marked as risky for general rollout because double-decode could be abused if attackers control RelayState payloads.

2026-03-14 09:12 - Support (Asha): Customer applied temporary edge rule to rewrite RelayState with a passthrough header containing tenant_hint; after that admin routes worked. Customer requests formal fix in product for private deployments to avoid custom edge rules.
investigation: - Confirmed failure mode is deterministic when RelayState contains percent-encoded querystring and corporate proxy performs encoding again.

- Identity-proxy trace: parse_relaystate() currently calls url_decode once and then url_parse on result. If key/value pairs still contain percent-encoding (e.g., tenant%3Dbeacon-prod) parser treats whole string as opaque and does not extract tenant parameter.

- Risk assessment: auto-double-decoding could mask other encoding issues and may open minor header injection vectors. Need input from security and product on safe heuristics (only for private tenant_hint param, only for signed SAML responses, or opt-in per-tenant flag).
- Repro in staging done with two methods: (1) reverse proxy that re-encodes RelayState, (2) crafting SAMLResponse with already-encoded RelayState. Both reproduce identical audit log lines and 403s.
- Related tickets: SUP-72134 (idp-hostname trailing dot), SUP-298741 (sso-state param normalization) — this is different because it is double-encoding not query normalization.
resolution: Workaround provided: customer configured an ingress rewrite to forward tenant hint in X-Redwood-Tenant header (temporary fix). Engineering created draft PR to attempt safe second-decoding on RelayState but gated behind per-tenant opt-in config for private deployments. Security review required before release. Next steps: (1) formalize opt-in flag and document in private deployment runbook; (2) land PR behind feature flag and coordinate staged rollout; (3) customer to remove temporary edge rule after tested rollout.
